data.readmeSummary:
## UK Company Financials (rein8/uk-company-financials)

Parses Companies House daily bulk iXBRL accounts (the Free Accounts Data Product) to extract structured UK company accounting figures: one row per company and accounting period containing company identifiers, period start/end and balance-sheet totals (net assets, fixed and current assets), cash, debtors and creditors split by short/long term, average employee headcount, dormant declaration, accounts type and reporting standard, audit status, prior-year comparatives, filing date, source file and filing-history link, plus derived credit signals (negative-net-assets indicator, short-term-creditors vs current-assets ratio, cash change vs prior year, employee change vs prior year, filing lag days). It reads the iXBRL tags (not PDFs or the keyed Companies House API), handles group-tagged values where present, drops personal-data tags before output, supports date-window scans up to 60 days back and incremental runs that return only new or changed rows. Coverage and signal statistics are exposed (typical daily file ≈17k filings; electronic coverage ~75%; net-asset figures present ≈98% of rows; employee note ≈90%; cash ≈46%; turnover/profits present in ≈2–3% of filings). Outputs are numeric amounts in filing currency and include prior-year comparatives where tagged.

## Use cases

- Credit control and lending: detect liabilities-above-assets, shrinking cash, short-term creditor pressure and filing lag for recent filers.  
- B2B sales and lead lists by company size: filter by headcount or balance-sheet size to build employer or target lists.  
- Accountants, strike-off and company formation services: find dormant filings, benchmark clients by accounts standard and audit status.  
- Brokers, M&A and invoice finance: surface larger filers that include turnover and profit (full FRS 102 / IFRS accounts).  
- Customer / supplier monitoring: check an explicit list of company numbers for recent accounts or run incremental checks to be notified when new accounts arrive.  
- Day-of-filing monitoring and bulk analysis: scan daily iXBRL bulk files for every set of accounts filed that day for market-data and research.  
- Data joins and enrichment: combine extracted financial rows with register snapshots to add address, SIC codes or company status for geographic or sector filtering.  
- Automated credit-risk sheets and employer/headcount reporting: produce credit-signal views and employer lists derived from balance-sheet and headcount tags.
